Enhanced GATE 6 in scripts/pre-commit to detect trivial companion file bypass. Previously blocked only when .deployed-hash was the SOLE staged file — could be bypassed by staging any trivial file (empty, .gitkeep, whitespace-only). Now verifies co-staged files contain meaningful changes by counting non-whitespace diff lines per file. Binary file diffs count as meaningful. Empty new files and whitespace-only additions are blocked. .deployed-hash not staged → GATE 6 SKIP. Tested 5 scenarios. 53/53 vitest pass.

Added auto-install for pre-commit hook via two paths: (1) Makefile install target symlinks scripts/pre-commit to .git/hooks/pre-commit (idempotent, skips when not in git repo), (2) npm prepare lifecycle script does the same on every npm install. Verified: make install creates symlink, npm run prepare succeeds silently, git commit --allow-empty blocked by GATE 1. 53/53 vitest pass. Fresh clones now get structural enforcement on first commit.
